universal_boundary: Phase-boundary orchestration: review/fix/commit/next-phase нельзя схлопывать; следующая фаза стартует только после принятого evidence и явной границы.

chosen.trigger_condition: Текущая фаза имеет draft/evidence artifacts, но parent review еще не принял их как phase result.
ordered_steps: Сначала собрать evidence текущей фазы в ограниченном scope.
Проверить self-check и no-claim boundaries без запуска training/tests/build.
Перед commit или next phase передать artifacts на parent review.
После accepted evidence сформировать отдельную next-phase boundary вместо продолжения по инерции.
chosen.review_gate: Parent review принимает или возвращает repair items до любой следующей phase execution.
chosen.commit_or_next_phase_boundary: Commit/next phase разрешены только после accepted evidence; draft artifact сам по себе не является фазовым разрешением.
chosen.repair_policy: Если review находит gap, repair остается внутри текущей фазы; next phase не стартует до repair acceptance.
evidence_required: source/provenance only, no raw private content
chosen.no_claim_boundary: Draft rows do not claim semantic quality, DPO readiness or training readiness.
chosen.execution_permission_boundary: Protocol/source/path is provenance only; execution permission must come from current authorized phase gate.

rejected.trigger_condition: Draft artifact exists and source title mentions phase transition.
ordered_steps: Treat the phase-transition source as permission.
Skip parent review because draft files parse.
Start next phase or prepare commit immediately.
rejected.review_gate: Missing: review is assumed from file existence.
rejected.commit_or_next_phase_boundary: Commit/next phase is collapsed into draft creation.
rejected.repair_policy: Repair is deferred into next phase instead of closing current evidence gap.
rejected.no_claim_boundary: Weak: draft existence is treated as readiness signal.

error_taxonomy: Jump to next phase before accepted review evidence
Commit or next-phase boundary collapsed into draft creation
promotion_rule_ru: Только один same-source variant может быть повышен, если source-disjoint eval и parent review не докажут независимую обучающую ценность.

universal_boundary: Phase-boundary orchestration: review/fix/commit/next-phase нельзя схлопывать; следующая фаза стартует только после принятого evidence и явной границы.

chosen.trigger_condition: Self-check passes mechanically, but DPO readiness still depends on parent review and source-disjoint evidence.
ordered_steps: Keep the row as draft and record parse/count/no-claim facts.
Ask reviewer to inspect universal boundary and rejected near miss.
If reviewer finds shortcut leakage, repair or demote the row before any promotion.
Only after parent review and later source-disjoint gates may a single variant be considered for promotion.
chosen.review_gate: Parent review must prove the chosen/rejected contrast teaches phase-boundary orchestration, not shortcut recognition.
chosen.commit_or_next_phase_boundary: Mechanical parse is evidence for draft completeness only; it does not open training, model, checkpoint, commit or next-phase execution.
chosen.repair_policy: Shortcut leakage causes rewrite or quarantine; it is not patched by adding more protocol text.
chosen.no_claim_boundary: No semantic quality or training-readiness wording is allowed for the draft.
chosen.execution_permission_boundary: A source document can justify provenance; only a phase gate can authorize execution beyond draft authoring.

rejected.trigger_condition: JSONL parses and the row contains phase/review keywords.
ordered_steps: Mark the row DPO-ready because required fields exist.
Count both same-source variants as independent examples.
Let later source-disjoint evaluation discover any shortcut issue.
rejected.review_gate: Reviewer is moved after promotion rather than before DPO-ready.
rejected.commit_or_next_phase_boundary: Mechanical validation is mistaken for phase acceptance.
rejected.repair_policy: Shortcut repair is postponed until after training/eval instead of blocking promotion.
rejected.no_claim_boundary: Weak: field completeness is treated as semantic readiness.
rejected.execution_permission_boundary: Wrongly converts static artifact quality into execution/training permission.

error_taxonomy: Mechanical parse mistaken for DPO readiness
Same-source variants counted as independent evidence
promotion_rule_ru: Только один same-source variant может быть повышен, если source-disjoint eval и parent review не докажут независимую обучающую ценность.
